verses.tl: Innaa anzalnaahu fee laylatin mubaarakatin innaa kunnaa mundhireen
Amran min indinaa innaa kunnaa mursileen
Rabbis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa in kuntum mooqineen
Laa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu rabbukum wa rabbu aabaa'ikumul-awwaleen
Annaa lahumudh-dhikraa wa qad jaa'ahum rasoolun mubeen
Thumma tawallaw anhu wa qaaloo mu'allamun majnoon
Wa laqad fatannaa qablahum qawma fir'awna wa jaa'ahum rasoolun kareem
An addoo ilayya ibaada Allaahi innee lakum rasoolun ameen
Wa an laa ta'loo alaa Allaahi innee aateekum bisultaanin mubeen
Wa innee udhtu birabbee wa rabbikum an tarjumoon
Wa in lam tu'minoo lee fa'taziloon
Fada'aa rabbahu anna haa'ulaa'i qawmun mujrimoon
Kam tarakoo min jannaatin wa uyoon
Famaa bakat alayhimus-samaa'u wal-ardu wa maa kaanoo munzareen
Wa laqad najjaynaa banee israa'eela minal-adhaabil-muheen
Min fir'awna innahu kaana aaleean minal-musrifeen
Wa laqadi ikhtarnaahum alaa ilmin alal-aalameen
Wa aataynaahum minal-aayaati maa feehi balaa'un mubeen
In hiya illaa mawtatunal-oolaa wa maa nahnu bimunshareen
Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubba'in wal-ladheena min qablihim ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen
Wa maa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
Maa khalaqnaahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Yawma laa yughnee mawlan an mawlan shay'an wa laa hum yunsaroon
Illaa man rahima Allaahu innahu huwal-azeezur-Raheem
Thumma subboo fawqa ra'sihi min adhaabil-hameem
Inna haadhaa maa kuntum bihi tamtaroon
Yalbasoona min sundusin wa istabraqin mutaqaabileen
Laa yadhooqoona feehal-mawta illal-mawtatal-oolaa wa waqaahum adhaabal-jaheem
